```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Academies' Accounts Returns (AAR) #

# AAR data downloaded from: https://financial-benchmarking-and-insights-tool.education.gov.uk/data-sources

options(scipen = 999)
# empty work space
rm(list = ls())
gc()

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(rlang)
library(data.table)

# create function to source code
source_code <- function(root_dir_name = "code", target_repo = "helper_functions", branch = "main", file_name = "file.R") {
  
  # Construct the raw GitHub URL
  git_url <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stefaniemeliss/", target_repo, "/", branch, "/", file_name)
  message("Trying to download: ", git_url)
  
  # Attempt to download from GitHub
  tempp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
  download_success <- tryCatch({
    curl::curl_download(git_url, tempp_file, quiet = FALSE)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Download failed: ", e$message)
    FALSE
  })
  
  if (download_success) {
    # If successful, source file
    source(tempp_file)
    unlink(tempp_file)
  } else {
    # Load local copy of file
    current_dir <- getwd()
    dir_components <- strsplit(current_dir, "/")[[1]]
    root_index <- which(dir_components == root_dir_name)
    if (length(root_index) == 0) {
      stop(paste("Root directory", root_dir_name, "not found in the current path"))
    }
    root_dir <- do.call(file.path, as.list(dir_components[1:root_index]))
    project_repo <- dir_components[root_index + 1]
    dir <- file.path(root_dir, project_repo)
    if (target_repo != project_repo) {
      dir <- gsub(project_repo, target_repo, dir)
    }
    file_path <- file.path(dir, file_name)
    print(paste("Directory:", dir))
    print(paste("File path:", file_path))
    source(file_path, local = parent.frame())
  }
}

# source functions
source_code(target_repo = "NDWF", file_name = "functions.R")

# define directories
get_directory()
dir <- get_directory()
dir_data <- file.path(dir, "data")
dir_misc <- file.path(dir, "misc")
dir_in <- file.path(dir_data, "academies-accounts-returns")
dir_tmp <- file.path(dir, "04_cost_eval", "tmp")
if(! dir.exists(dir_tmp)) dir.create(dir_tmp)

# Get Information about Schools #

# read in establishment data
gias <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(dir_data, "data_gias_estab.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8"))

# remove all establishments without an LAESTAB (i.e., Children's centres, British schools overseas, Online providers)
gias <- gias[!is.na(gias$LAESTAB), ]

# only use open schools
gias <- gias[grepl("Open", gias$establishmentstatus), ]
gc()

# GIAS for treated
gias_treated <- gias %>% 
  filter(group_uid == 2939 | URN == 148094) %>%
  arrange(group_uid, URN)

# define urn and laestab
urn_treated <- gias_treated$URN
laestab_treated <- gias_treated$LAESTAB

# Prepare AAR data #

meta <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "04_cost_eval", "meta_packs.csv"))

# contains running cost related information (e.g., pupil counts, % FSM, % SEN)
# details on actual spend in each cost category, total income and total expenditure
aar <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(dir_data, "data_aar.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8"))

# process cost data and aggregate at year level
aar <- aar %>%
  group_by(time_period, URN) %>%
  mutate(academy_type = ifelse(n() > 1, "aggregated across more than 1 entry", academy_type)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    perc_pup_sen = sum(c(perc_pup_sen_ehcp, perc_pup_sen_support), na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_period, ESTAB_NAME, LAESTAB, URN, academy_type, fte_teachers, fte_pup, perc_pup_fsm, perc_pup_sen) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      matches("^(cost|income|expend|period)"),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ), .groups = "drop"
  )

# determine variables of interest for cost eval
# define AAR measures of interest
vars <- names(aar)[grepl("inc|expend|cost_staff_pay", names(aar))]
vars <- names(aar)[grepl("inc|expend|cost_staff_pay_teaching|cost_staff_pay_tot_|cost_staff_tot|cost_staff_other_tot|cost_education_tot", names(aar))]
vars <- names(aar)[grepl("inc|expend|cost_staff_tot", names(aar))]
```


```{r render-school-sections, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# urn_school <- urn_treated[1] # debug

# Loop through each treated school URN.
# For each school, render the child Rmd once using that school's data.
for (urn_school in urn_treated) {
  
  # Render the child document 'child_analyse_aar.Rmd'.
  # This returns the knitted markdown as text rather than writing a separate file.
  cat(
    knitr::knit_child(
      input = "child_analyse_aar.Rmd",
      
      # Create a temporary environment for this school.
      # This passes the objects below into the child document so it can use them.
      envir = list2env(
        list(
          # The current school being processed in this iteration.
          urn_school = urn_school,
          
          # Full vector of treated school URNs.
          urn_treated = urn_treated,
          
          # Main GIAS dataset.
          gias = gias,
          
          # Subset of GIAS for treated schools.
          gias_treated = gias_treated,
          
          # Main AAR dataset.
          aar = aar,
          
          # Variables to plot.
          vars = vars,
          
          # Metadata table used for variable descriptions.
          meta = meta,
          
          # Temporary directory used for downloaded comparator files.
          dir_tmp = dir_tmp
        ),
        
        # Use the current chunk environment as the parent.
        # This means the child can also see objects already available there,
        # such as helper functions, themes and colour objects.
        parent = environment()
      ),
      
      # Suppress progress output from knit_child during rendering.
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    
    # Write the returned markdown into the main document.
    sep = "\n\n"
  )
  
  # Ask R to run garbage collection after each school.
  # This may help clear temporary objects created during that child's render.
  gc()
}
```

  cat("Religious character:", gias_treated$religiouscharacter[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
  cat("Local authority:", gias_treated$la[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
  cat("Region:", gias_treated$gor[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
  
  
  # download comparison data
  url <- paste0("https://financial-benchmarking-and-insights-tool.education.gov.uk/school/", urn_school, "/comparison/download")
  file_name <- file.path(dir_tmp, paste0(urn_school, ".zip"))
  download.file(url, destfile = file_name, mode = "wb")
  zip::unzip(file_name, exdir = dir_tmp)
  file.remove(file_name)
  
  # Benchmark spending: define comparator dfs
  # 30 similar schools to benchmark this school against running cost categories, which includes all staffing (excluding premises staff), ICT, consultancy and catering.
  df_comp_pupil <- read.csv(file = file.path(dir_tmp, paste0("comparison-", urn_school, "-pupil.csv")))
  
  # extract comparator URNs after removing any treated schools
  urn_comp <- df_comp_pupil %>%
    filter(! URN %in% urn_treated) %>%
    pull(URN)
  
  # get AAR data for treated school
  aar_school <- aar %>%
    filter(URN == urn_school)
  
  # get AAR data for comparator schools
  aar_comp <- aar %>%
    filter(URN %in% urn_comp)
  
  # identify URNs of schools for regional average
  gias_region <- gias %>%
    tidyr::replace_na(list(admissionspolicy = "unknown", boarders = "unknown")) %>% 
    filter(
      grepl("Open", establishmentstatus),
      ! URN %in% urn_treated,
      phaseofeducation %in% unique(c(gias_treated$phaseofeducation[gias_treated$URN == urn_school])),
      gor %in% c(gias_treated$gor[gias_treated$URN == urn_school]),
      ! parliamentaryconstituency %in% unique(c(gias_treated$parliamentaryconstituency[gias_treated$URN == urn_school])),
      ! grepl("Boarding school", boarders),
      admissionspolicy != "Selective"
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  # extract comparator URNs in same region
  urn_region <- gias_region %>%
    pull(URN)
  
  # get AAR data for regional average across phase type
  aar_region <- aar %>%
    filter(URN %in% urn_region)
  
  # combine data
  df <- bind_rows(aar_school %>%
                    mutate(group = "Treated"), 
                  aar_comp %>%
                    mutate(group = "Comparator set average")) %>%
    bind_rows(., aar_region %>%
                mutate(group = "Regional phase average"))
